**Calendar event (Sept 3, 14:00–14:45 JST, Celine + Bako):**

- ❌ No mention of accommodations, complaints, applicant identity, or any denial/characterization of sealed matters — [chat_20007]'s request to add denial language would itself disclose those categories.

Both calls are independent, so I'll make them together.
